snippet.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved | Roundtable Reveal
snippet.description:
Halo: Campaign Evolved – a faithful yet modernized remake of the Halo: Combat Evolved campaign – is coming to Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 in 2026. In this developer roundtable, the Halo Studios team shares insights on the overall vision and some of the new enhancements and features being added to this timeless classic. 

Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, and refined controls, plus three brand-new prequel missions featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability. 

Play it your way: solo, 2-player splitscreen co-op on console, or up to 4-player online co-op on console and PC with full crossplay and cross-progression support. Whether you’re discovering Halo for the first time or returning to the ring after 25 years, Halo: Campaign Evolved delivers an adventure that feels both timeless and brand new.
